Name: Legacy Farm
Author: ItsLunatyx
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][center]﻿[img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/27/ee13da09a520ad0e8d88ea532f45cc32.png[/img][/center]
[center]⭐Fully compatible with 1.6! ⭐[/center]
[center]This large farm map will give you the freedom to design your farm however you'd like, with a large amount of space and extra areas too, for fun! It has a Junimo Treehouse with warps to the Desert, the Mountain, the Beach, Ginger Island, Ridgeside Village, and East Scarp. For those that prefer to play with only some of the expansions, or no expansions at all, there are multiple versions
I've made available to download! Please see the 'Versions Available' section below, for more information.

[b]*** Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18954/]Legacy Farm Cave[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18991/]Legacy Greenhouse[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21220]Legacy Coops and Barns[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19494]Legacy Community Center Bundles[/url]﻿ 
now available for download, to add even more to your game! *** [/b][/center][center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/49d7e378dca8bd1b15b0e835758435af.png[/img][/center]⭐A Junimo Treehouse with magic warps!
⭐Your very own quarry, right there on your farm!
⭐A Farm Forest to the left of your farm that has re-spawnable stumps and foragables!
⭐A Vineyard style planting area to the left of your farm, complete with a winery/storage/planting building!
⭐A Waterfall cave by your river, to replenish your energy like the bathhouse! 
⭐River and Lake fish can be caught on the farm!
⭐Salmonberry/Blackberry Bushes are dotted around the farm, and the extra areas, for even more foraging!
⭐Foragables will spawn in the farm forest, and on the farm itself, just like on the forest farm!
[center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/61fef8dc261b7df19144f4a1e9300bcd.png[/img][/center]⭐﻿All versions of Legacy Farm replace the Standard Farm in game. 
⭐All areas are diggable and buildable on the farm.
⭐The extra areas are also diggable, so no restrictions on planting or designing your farm however you want to. However, please bare in mind that you won't be able to place farm buildings in these extra areas, only on the farm map itself, as normal. 
⭐Dig spots won't work in the extra areas of the farm forest and vineyard as they're not technically part of the farm map either but they do sometimes give seeds. Just not artifacts or stuff.
⭐If you're unsure which warp you need, or forget where each one leads, talk to the Junimo's next to each one! They'll let you know!
⭐The Junimo Treehouse, and the Magic Warps inside, are available from day 1 for you! However, it's entirely up to you if and when you choose to use them! If you'd prefer to have more of a challenge, check out this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19205/]Legacy Farm Progression Unlock[/url]﻿ created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24584859]brifoundthebingus[/url]! This will lock the Junimo Treehouse until after you have completed the Community Centre or Joja Warehouse. 
[center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/312ff2206fcdc93139561009937abdfb.png[/img][/center]⭐[b]The '[/b][b]Original' Version[/b]: has all of the above and is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. This is the version you want if you [u]do[/u] play with Ridgeside, East Scarp and Stardew Valley Expanded.

⭐[b]The 'Ridgeside with SVE' Version[/b]: is for those that play with Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside, but [u]not[/u] East Scarp. The East Scarp warp on the right of the Junimo Treehouse, is replaced with the SVE Secret Woods warp in this version. 

⭐[b]The 'Ridgeside Only' Version:[/b] This is for those that play with just Ridgeside Village and no other expansions. The warp for Ridgeside will be on the right of the Junimo Treehouse, and the warp to the left will take you to the Secret Woods. 

⭐[b]The 'Vanilla' Version:[/b]  Is made for those that don't play with Ridgeside, East Scarp or Stardew Valley Expanded and would prefer only 'Vanilla' game warps. In the Vanilla version, the expansion warps are replaced with the Sewer warp (right) and the Secret Woods warp (left). Please note this version won't be compatible with SVE Secret Woods due to the warp points aimed at the vanilla game locations. This is the version you want if you [u]don't[/u] play with Ridgeside, East Scarp and/or Stardew Valley Expanded.

⭐[b]The 'Vanilla with SVE' Version[/b]: This version is exactly the same as the above Vanilla version, but for those that play with Stardew Valley Expanded only, and need the warp to that version of the Secret Woods. This is the version you want if you play [u]with[/u] Stardew Valley Expanded, but [u]not[/u] Ridgeside and/or East Scarp.

[left][/left][center]I hope that all makes sense! Any questions, or if you're still unsure what version to download, please do let me know. 

This is the first time I've ever done this and I'm still learning, but I'm so proud of how it's turned out.
I have play tested it a lot, but if you come across anything I may have missed please let me know.
As I'm so new to this, I would really appreciate any feedback as I'm learning and making it better.

I've had so much fun creating this map and I hope you enjoy it as much as I am! ﻿[/center][center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/e35145a1e0ccdd3f02a99f833ff3ab1a.png[/img][/center][center][youtube]jawZvSIaw0w[/youtube][/center]

I thought I'd put together a video to show the mods I've created so far for Stardew Valley, so you can see them in game! All are fully compatible with the latest 1.6 update! Time stamps and links are below for your convenience so you can skip to any particular mod you want to see. Thank you for all the amazing comments and feedback on Nexus so far, I appreciate it so, so much. I hope you continue to have fun with these and enjoy them as much as I am!  PS I realised I forgot to show the vineyard in Legacy Farm but I'll make sure to next time! There are pictures on Nexus <3
